summary: Agi Inc, the Brazilian NYSE-listed holding company for Banco Agibank, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 3Q26 earnings release and a founder letter to stakeholders. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium or dates are stated. Disclosures include 62.8% QoQ EBT growth, 37.8% QoQ net income growth to R$276.0 million, 8.3 million active customers, 10.0% INSS payroll credit share, and over 700 thousand Agi+ subscribers. The filing also notes appointment of Rafael Siqueira as Chief Technology Officer, a routine appointment rather than an abrupt departure. No special-situation event; monitor ordinary operating momentum.
